description: The Indian Institute of Carpet Technology (IICT) is a Ministry of Textiles, Government of India institute established to support the textile, carpet and allied industries. Its campus is in Bhadohi, has operated since 2001, and is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and approved by AICTE.

agent_notes: Normal TLS verification to Google and iict.ac.in returned the managed proxy's self-signed-certificate-in-chain error; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the confirmed search and official iict.ac.in hostnames.

The official site explicitly marks distance courses as discontinued on its main course page. Short-term pages are tied to 2024-25, 2024, or 2025 training material, so those entries were treated as expired short-term offerings and excluded.

The official site contains a current 2026-27 B.Tech admissions page but links a 2025-26 brochure and retains older short-term catalogue material, so a complete current active-programme catalogue could not be established.
Official institution pages identify the campus as Bhadohi but do not explicitly state the administrative district name; district remains unverified under the source restriction.
